ctx.x: Well, I think Peanuts joined me in '41, either late '40 or -- yeah, in '40, I think it was he joined me, late '40 and '41, '42, '43. Those years. And '44.

Let's see, the next picture that is listed here is "Idea Girl," 1946, directed by Will Jason. Light, unpretentious Universal comedy with music, about a music publisher's relationship with a dizzy blond song saleswoman. Features Charlie Barnet and His Orchestra, with three numbers. This is where "Xango," "I Don't Care," and, "I Can't Get You Off My Mind." And this is where -- 1946 -- where Killian couldn't be shown.
